scope: Frozen collector false-PASS and receipt custody boundaries. Runtime cleanup repair and future source/profile/product admission are separate and remain closed.
verifiedBoundaries: Exactly13 string invocation fields, same App/UI source, method, owned device and opposite app/OS languages; actual retained initial setting bytes are hashed and compared.

All29 catalog groups or all6 live groups require the precise native/context/AX/PNG quartet, plus the original final context/AX/PNG trio. Exact method/device, success-associated manifest rows, unique typed labels and retained raw hashes are required. Unknown selected-prefix attachments and duplicates are rejected.

Complete typed native/read-only observation shape, mounted identifier-to-block hashes, actual body SHA and UTF16 length, native type, typed style values, and one-to-one ordered block identity are checked. Full nativeStyleJSON is retained across saved-to-cold and live comparisons.

Nine distinct original catalog documents share one owned Space and pre-cold App PID. The before-menu insertion preserves the original paragraph and has actual mounted vertical order. A single distinct cold PID must recover the same hierarchy object IDs, block IDs, bodies and full saved styles.

Every UTF16 unit in nonempty text must have a contiguous qualified assigned-font and paragraph run. Empty text must instead carry the qualified typingFont/typingParagraph. The live phases retain native read, original IDs, selection and responder state; every run grows beyond the nominal size and the source-qualified primary font returns exactly. Per-glyph fallback and visual acceptance are not claimed.

Raw private requests bind exact preceding native attachment bytes, invocation, nonce, runner PID and App PID. Raw response SHA/content matches the Swift attachment and actual retained simctl readback. The two nonces are distinct and the runner identity is stable.

Actual command/result/process-exit pins require exact73bb lifecycle identity, successful zero exit, retained initial argv/PID/PGID fields, positive absent group status and original process-exit SHA. Setter/readback argv includes the same owned simulator; actual log bytes and chronological placement inside the XCTest interval are checked. Final restore/set/read must succeed after that execution interval.

The collector returns only OBSERVATIONS_MATCH_SOURCE_VISUAL_REVIEW_PENDING and explicitly refuses standalone product/XCTest authority. Exact one-case result, descriptor, destination and process authority remain the unchanged original runner responsibility.
conditionalBoundary: This review binds only collector71c and runtime2d87 schema. Any later closure-sidecar/schema change needs its own small comparison; STYLED-RUN-01 remains a separate known runtime blocker until Interfaces repairs it.
limitations: PNG checks preserve typed actual artifacts; they are not a visual review.
Assigned UIFont observations do not establish per-glyph fallback faces.
Original source-qualified XCTest asserts the exact UIKit content-size category enum raw values; the collector does not invent platform enum strings.
No actual producer or simulator compatibility is established by this source review.
